content: Om (also written as Aum) is the sacred primordial sound and symbol of the universe in Hindu philosophy. According to the Mandukya Upanishad, Om encompasses all of existence: the past, present, and future. It is considered the sound of Brahman, the ultimate reality, and is used as a mantra in meditation and spiritual practice.
